# zenfra_team_membership (Resource)

Adds a user of the organization to a team. The user must be an active member of the organization; a user can belong to several teams. Requires an Admin token. Available after the organization's access-boundary activation; until then the API refuses the write with `access_boundaries_inactive`.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# A team of one gives a single person access to a subtree.
resource "zenfra_team_membership" "alice" {
  team_id = zenfra_team.platform.id
  user_id = var.alice_user_id
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `team_id` (String) The team. Changing it replaces the membership.
- `user_id` (String) The user. Changing it replaces the membership.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Composite identifier in the format team_id/user_id.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import zenfra_team_membership.alice $TEAM_ID/$USER_ID
```
